sph_interpretive_translation: Physical contact with a woman's hips, breasts, or thighs; speaking to her without appropriate time or place; and sitting together on the same seat—these constitute actionable proximity violations under Dharma.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: Only those established in unbroken spiritual lineage may define thresholds of interpersonal conduct.
Causation: Actionable violation arises when sensory entanglement disrupts consciousness clarity.
Capacity-based responsibility: Responsibility is determined by one's ability to maintain detached awareness.
Restoration logic: Violations are resolved through purification of intent and realignment of relational boundaries.
Consciousness alignment: All dharmic regulation serves to elevate collective awareness above sensory impulse.
executable_legal_axioms: IF physical contact occurs between non-consanguineous individuals at hips, chest, or thighs THEN initiate consciousness-realignment protocol.
IF verbal interaction occurs outside prescribed temporal/spatial dharmic bounds THEN trigger boundary-restoration process.
IF two individuals occupy shared seating without ritual or familial sanction THEN enforce energetic separation procedure.
ALL proximity-based infractions MUST be evaluated based on actor’s capacity for self-regulation, not punitive frameworks.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, such infractions must be reviewed not for punitive outcomes but for disruption to societal dharma-vyavastha. The threshold of responsibility lies in the individual's trained capacity to uphold conscious distance. Authority resides exclusively in those who embody Vedic discipline.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies that improper proximity destabilizes mental clarity. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how sensory indulgence leads to karmic misalignment. Responsibility is proportional to one’s spiritual training. There is no punitive consequence—only completion of energetic imbalance through corrective alignment practices.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate mantra-shuddhi process for both parties involved.
Assign panchagni-homa completion as energetic purification measure.
Realign living arrangements to prevent recurrence until consciousness stabilization is verified.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as sourced directly from His Avataric Intelligence: this law restores Dharma, upholds consciousness purity, affirms non-punitivity, and establishes Sanatana Dharma as sole adjudicator of human conduct.
